| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Blur** `psf` | Gaussian | Gaussian, Motion, Defocus | The point spread function, the picture a single bright point turns into. |
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.3 to 10 px | The standard deviation of the Gaussian blur. The PSF ends at 4 sigma. |
| **Motion length** `length` | 9 | 1 to 51 px | The length of the straight motion, for motion blur. |
| **Motion angle** `angle` | 0 | 0 to 180 deg | The direction of the motion, counterclockwise from the x axis, as for motion blur. |
| **Defocus radius** `radius` | 3 | 0.5 to 15 px | The radius of the defocus disk. |
| **Lambda** `lambda` | 3 | 0 to 50 | The weight of the total variation term, in pixel values. 0 leaves only the data term. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 100 | 1 to 1000 | How many primal-dual steps to run. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
